declarations.comment: First sentence 'Introduces a region context.' is grammatically correct and properly declarative, but it is the only prose the reader ever sees — the outer comment with the examples and explanation of what a region context actually is does not attach to the declaration in Scaladoc. The @return compensates somewhat, but a brief expansion of the opening sentence (e.g., 'Introduces a region context in which mutable fields receive distinct abstract representations.') would make the rendered summary self-sufficient.
